combos_and_parlays#u4.detail: Verified the combos record had no weather input (environment was GAP). Added new input nfl.combo_shared_weather_leg_coupling (calm/moderate/severe weather regime conditioning the joint draw; leg pairs total x QB yards, total x kicker/long FG, QB x receiver yards, total x rusher, kicker x team total), stage s8 using it with nfl.weather_pit, nfl.weather_total_response and nfl.kicker, a threshold interaction, a weather required_data entry, and set environment to COVERED. Leg-pair elasticities themselves remain an empirical fit.

combos_and_parlays#u5.detail: Confirmed no cross-archetype output contract existed. Added new input nfl.sibling_leg_marginal_interface to combos_and_parlays: interface v1 naming producer archetypes (spread, game/team total, QB yards, receiving, rushing, TD scorer, half/quarter totals), per-leg P(yes) under each leg's settlement rule, and a shared-seed 20,000-draw matrix (home/away points, regulation points, OT flag, plays, QB/key-player active flags, weather bin, leg stat) with consistency checks; stage s1 now references it.

game_events#u1.detail: Rule era verified online (2025 league-meeting reports; PFT OT explainer): regular-season OT since 2025 = both teams possess, 10 minutes, then sudden death, ties possible; the first team can win on a full-period scoring drive. Audit fix: corrected try logic (a TD that wins outright has no try, e.g. SB LVIII 25-22). A FG answered by a TD ends 3 or 6 apart; margins 4-5 come from a TD+try answered by a FG. Rewrote stage g2 and patched nfl.ot_model and nfl.ot_ending_hazard measurements. Patched nfl.ot_total_increment to be market-free with era-simulated OT points (9-17 possible); its audits in game_total and slate_extremes are now KEEP_CONTEXT, and the slate why was re-attached.

off_field_events#u3.detail: Verified series_assignment.json: KXNFLOWNERSTAKE and KXNFLSTADIUM were re-filed to OUT_OF_SCOPE (franchise_ownership_business, team_facilities), so only the celebrity series (KXNFLHKANE, KXNFLCOMPETE) and venue retention (KXNFLGAMELOCATION) still lacked a class. Patched nfl.offfield_base_rate (mechanism, rationale, measurement, sources, raw_data) with per-series reference classes, incl. a cross-sport-athlete signing/snap class with Beta(0.5,0.5) prior and an international-game retention class, and explicit exclusion of the two re-filed series; stage o6 now uses it.

season_awards#u7.detail: Ballot formats verified online: AP MVP since 2022 is a 50-voter top-5 ballot scored 10-5-3-2-1 (Stafford 366/24 firsts vs Maye 361/23); other AP awards and COY use top-3 scored 5-3-1. Patched nfl.vote_outcome_model and nfl.teammate_vote_split_penalty. Audit fix: nfl.vote_outcome_model is now the first input of the aggregation stage s6, attached to season_awards as primary (archetype_patches/NFL_a.json) with an input_audit entry. nfl.leader_order_statistic was demoted to secondary as a ballot feature, the 'plurality' summary text was replaced, and the KXNFLMVP variant was updated.

team_total#u6.detail: Audit fix: the catalog-level why texts in team_total still named KXNFLBOTH. archetype_patches/NFL_a.json now detaches and re-attaches nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean and nfl.paired_score_covariance_own with single-team KXNFLTEAMTOTAL whys. nfl.paired_score_covariance_own was re-patched from a Gaussian copula (zero tail dependence) to a per-bin Student-t copula (rho, nu, lambda_U) with a held-out P(both>=28/35/42) check, so it outputs the joint pmf. game_total stage t7 no longer calls it 'built for' KXNFLBOTH; the tail calibration stays open as game_total u5.

unreg:combine_testing_results#u6.detail: Kalshi events API (2026-11-08) shows VERT26, BROAD26, BENCH26 and 4026. Added nfl.combine_bench_press_pool_and_prior and nfl.combine_vertical_jump_prior, stage s6 and a joint interaction, and patched nfl.combine_drill_extreme_history for vertical/bench maxima. Audit fix: replaced the stale settlement_contract coverage note ('other drills unresolved'); stage s4 now covers all four drills; catalog contract_types now list vertical and bench via archetype_patches. Vertical/bench rules text is still unretrievable, which is recorded.

unreg:fantasy_points_markets#u2.detail: Full live KXNFLFFPTS rules read via the Kalshi API give the Sleeper kicker table (FG 0-39 +3, 40-49 +4, 50-59 +5, 60+ +6, XP +1, misses -1) and the D/ST table (+10..-4 points-allowed tiers); D/ST markets are live. Added nfl.fantasy_kicker_points_chain, nfl.fantasy_dst_points_chain, stage s11 and two interactions, and corrected s5. Audit fix: replaced the contradictory variants_and_edge_cases[0] ('kicker weights unverified') with the verified tables.

unreg:slate_extremes#u2.detail: The Kalshi API list of KXNFLGAMESPECIALS-27 has passing, receiving, receptions, TDs, sacks, tackles, INTs, D/ST TDs, 100/100 and quarter rungs (OT excluded). Added nfl.player_single_game_stat_extreme_family and nfl.player_single_quarter_stat_extreme, stages s7/s8, a quote, an interaction and a nonlinearity. Audit fix: rewrote the stale variant that said only rushing was sampled. Catalog contract_types now cover every stat and quarter rung via archetype_patches, and the nfl.ot_total_increment why was refreshed.

unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials#u.detail: The required fix is splitting the archetype into per-family archetype keys and remapping 15 series, which is not possible in this pass. series_assignment still maps all 15 to this key. Partial cleanup only: series-to-stage routing in the record, stage s4 (team yards) given volume inputs (nfl.pace, nfl.drives, nfl.script), and stale contract_types ('Team 1st downs', 'Safeties') replaced through archetype_patches with the 15 live families.
